data.description: Historical OpenDPD metrics as implemented in utils/metrics.py (OpenDPDv1/v2 papers and benchmark_report.md).

metrics.aggregation: mean of sub-channel ratios, then dB
metrics.formula: 20*log10(mean over segments of mean over sub-channels of mean|X_pred - X_ref| / mean|X_ref|), FFT of nperseg samples
metrics.name: EVM
metrics.notes: Not a demodulated constellation EVM. Do not compare with standard EVM.

metrics.name: ACLR_L
metrics.notes: Leakage convention (adjacent / strongest main sub-channel): negative dBc, lower is better.

metrics.name: ACLR_R
metrics.notes: Leakage convention (adjacent / strongest main sub-channel): negative dBc, lower is better.

parameters.aggregation: NMSE and EVM are means of per-segment values (dB and ratio respectively), not pooled
parameters.normalization: none; signals compared as stored (target = gain * input for DPD)
parameters.psd: scipy.signal.welch, nperseg=nperseg, scaling=spectrum, two-sided, mean over segments
parameters.segmenting: independent nperseg segments from the dataset spec; the last segment is zero-padded
